snippet.title: REDLINE — Strings of Fate | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
REDLINE is a sci-fi romance visual novel set in a near-future coastal city in southern Japan, where gifted individuals can perceive, interpret, and influence human emotions — abilities now at the center of scientific research and corporate ambition.

You play as a university student with the rare ability to perceive emotional connections as red threads. As you become entangled in a secretive research program and drawn toward five distinct love interests, your choices will shape not only your relationships, but the fate of society itself.



Opening Theme:「僕らの赤い糸」(Our Red Thread)
Produced by Lunatic Parfait
Vocals by Zhavanya Meidi

Steam page coming soon.

#OtomeGame #RomanceGame #IndieGame #VisualNovel
